text.text:
Edit/Update: I don't know why, but after the owners read this review,  their lengthy, condescending reply filled with excuses was deleted.

Well, every other negative review has a response from the owner with a short, condescending novel with excuses thrown in offering no solutions or apologies, so let's see if the pattern continues!

The room was spacious and the bathroom was nice (Steel Horse Room). The bed was uncomfortable- blow up air mattress and the thermostat was automatically set to 75°, which was adjusted after expressing concern, so that was good.

We did not experience the "warm welcome" that the other guests had expressed. The owner let his dogs walk up to us, clearly overexcited, seemingly out of control, then he quickly yelled at them calling them Dumb and Dumber (not their names) and telling them to sit. This happened twice while we were there for 2 days which tells me this may have been done for attention. We ran into both owners a few times and were never asked how our stay is going. There clearly lacks a hospitality background/experience.

The food was extremely lack luster. I promise it won't exceed expectations. You'd get more quality and quantity at a hotel. The owners don't seem to have great social skills so when the older gentleman sat with us and another couple, the vibe was a little awkward since he's not friendly. The kitchen looks disheveled (not clean like a restaurant) and there is a hint of urine smell in the living room that we're 100% sure the owners are unaware of.

The house could use some basic clean up around the yard and the porch- this would go a long way for first impressions when walking up. The metal sculptures are mediocre at best which is why you haven't heard of this "artist" until you checked out the place online first. There are 2 old vehicles and a run down boat parked where the guests are supposed to park. I get the classic appeal, but make more room for the guests and remove that broken down boat. It's starting to look like a scrap yard.

Thanksgiving night we invited my dad over to chat in the living room and at 10:04pm the lady owner comes out and speaks to us like children that the quiet time is 10pm. I understand that rule, not far-fetched, but her communication skills were extremely condescending. It's a holiday night, let loose a little.

There are many aspects of this property that could be improved with minimal effort, but unfortunately the owners invested in a restaurant while admitting they've never worked in the industry 🙃 This seems to take away from the B&B.

We booked based on the warm welcoming reviews and 4-5 star place, but did not receive any welcome and saw a 2 star set-up. With all the flaws we would've enjoyed our stay, but they were not nice people. Theres no point in trying to express these concerns to the owners since they've been so distant and short with us. I can garentee this review wont be responded with solutions or apologies nor will the B&B be improved, refer to other reviews for reference excuses and responses. A little hospitality would've made all the difference. We're clearly not the only ones that had this experience.

My stay at the JW Marriott Orlando, Grande Lakes was enjoyable overall, but there was a significant issue that needs to be addressed.
The property itself is beautiful, the pool area is fantastic, and the food at the restaurants was excellent. The resort has a great atmosphere, and much of the staff we encountered were friendly and professional.
However, I was very disappointed to see non-service animals inside two of the restaurants, including sitting on the bench seating where guests dine. Under Florida law (509.233), animals are not permitted in restaurants unless they are legitimate service animals. Seeing this in a resort of this caliber was surprising and concerning.
I brought the issue to the attention of two different managers, and unfortunately both responses suggested it was not viewed as a serious concern. Respectfully, it is a serious issue. Health regulations exist for a reason, and guests should be able to dine without worrying about animals being allowed in restaurant seating areas.
Aside from this problem, the stay itself was pleasant. However, the lack of concern from management regarding compliance with restaurant health regulations was disappointing and is something the hotel should address to maintain the standards expected from a property like this.

We booked unit 3114 Brasilia Ave through Expedia with Wonder Vacation Homes. The apartment was exactly as described and worked really well for our group of 6 adults. Lots of space, very clean, and the location was convenient — about 15-20 minutes drive to the Disney parks. Check-in/out instructions were clear and easy to follow.

My only suggestion for WVH: please add a contact phone number on the sticker at the front door. We had an issue where the door code malfunctioned and my phone was inside, so we couldn’t get in or access the reservation info. The front desk couldn’t help since they don’t manage WVH properties. It took about 30 minutes to find a contact number online. WVH was helpful once we reached them, but maintenance took over 3 hours to arrive. The lock kept making a sound the whole time. Luckily one of my sons got in through an open second-floor balcony door before maintenance arrived. In the end, the handyman said that the door lock was functioning normally. Glad it worked out, but a phone number on the door would’ve saved us a lot of time and stress.

Other than that hiccup, we had a good stay. If they add that phone number and sort the lock reliability, this place would be perfect for groups.

Rating 4/5 due to the communication system oddities and inefficiencies and the unit itself needing some minor attention. We would book again with Wonder though but I hope they can figure out a smoother system. I will say they were more responsive than we've experienced with Deconova even though Deconova had a more straightforward invoice and communication process.

I booked this place last minute because of the waterpark feature. The hotel itself looks a little run down from the outside (and other buildings around it). Once inside you could tell they were starting a remodel or rearranging.  While you could tell the hotel was really making an effort to remodel and make it a better place...it just wasn't quite there yet. Here's what we liked and didn't like:
Likes - The staff was friendly both at the reception and the pool staff. We booked a standard double bed room, and got an upgrade to a larger family suite. That was a plus! The room had a kitchenette, small table with 4 chairs, bunk beds, and pullout couch, in the bedroom was a king bed and chair. Both rooms had a flatscreen tv.  It was a nice size room especially for a family. The hotel does have a waterpark - it was enough to entertain my 9yr old for a few hours, but even after that he was ready to go do something else. They did have an arcade, and family activities (we didn't participate in any of them though). DISLIKES: carpets and couch were stained badly. On our way there, we wished we had known that the neighborhood wasn't really a "good" part of town - though it probably isn't the worst... thankfully we never had an incident. The toddler water play area looked dangerous.. while the slides and water were fine the metal handrails were extremely rotted and rusty - I was worried for my toddlers safety. Finally, there were no linens on the bunks, and no blankets anywhere in the room - we called down and they did bring us some and we put them on the beds ourselves... While this wasn't the worst place I ever stayed it's not the best either.

For us, it’s not just a space for play… it’s a space that supports connection, trust, and growth.

We rented the villa we stayed at earlier this year through Bella Vida Vacation Homes whose office is located on the Bella Vida gated Community.
There were 7 of us in a 6 bed villa with pool and jacuzzi. We paid extra to have the pool and jacuzzi heated.
We arrived late Saturday evening after a long journey and discovered that the wifi didn't work nor did any of the tvs. We contacted the manager, Adriana Betancourt, and she replied that she was waiting to hear back from a tech to see if he could stop by. Meanwhile, the wifi went back on. We then discovered that there was no knob on the jacuzzi switch to turn it on and the pool heating was not on.
She told us that nothing could be done as it was the weekend and it would have to be checked on Monday.

This resulted in a huge party in which we had armed police all around our villa and surrounding area, police helicopters with search lights and still the gate wasn't fixed.
I wouldn't advise anyone to use this company.
